items.title: MxScout on a company machine: how it is deployed
items.reported: Make this an idea to import: the deployment architecture of MxScout on a company machine, levels 1 and 2.

history.what: Written from deployment-architecture/deployment.json, levels 1 and 2 of C4.

now.summary: MxScout runs on each person's own machine, next to Studio Pro and the Mendix project's git clone; nothing is hosted.
now.story:
A team member clones the Mendix project, starts MxScout from its own clone (Node 22, no install) and opens it in the browser on 127.0.0.1:4289. MxScout reads the .mpr and writes its documentation into the project's mxscout/ folder, which goes to the team through the project's git like any other file.

Claude Code or Codex works in the same project with the Mendix skills and hands its work to MxScout through the inbox. The only things that leave the machine are what the person commits and the files they choose to send.

proposal.summary: Keep it this way: one MxScout per person, the team shares through the Mendix project's git, and the drawing below is the agreed picture.

Which machines the team members use (Windows or macOS) is not drawn; MxScout runs the same on both from a clone, without an install.
